summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 1, 2026, disclosing management changes effective the same day. Nobuki Watanabe was appointed Managing Executive Officer of the Infrastructure Business Unit, responsible for the Osaka IR Business, while relinquishing his prior role as Representative Director and Chairman of MGM Osaka Corporation. The change is an internal promotion and reassignment, not a forced or abrupt departure. No financial terms, consideration, or deal mechanics are involved. This is a routine organizational update, but because the filing centers on a specific management change as the announced event, it is classified accordingly. Investors should monitor for any subsequent strategic shifts in ORIX's Osaka IR initiative.
